_comment: THE DEV CORS ALLOWLIST, DECLARED ONCE (#349).
Three backends need this list and none of them may be the source of it.
Before this file each hardcoded its own copy, and the copies had already
drifted: fastapi and node allowed http://localhost:3000, django did not.
Nobody decided that; it is what three hand-maintained lists do.
This is the DEFAULT only. Every backend reads CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS from the
environment and falls back to this list, following the DJANGO_SECRET_KEY
precedent in settings.py — a dev default, an environment override, and a
name that says which it is.
scripts/check-cors-parity.mjs asserts all three still agree with this file.
It is a SOURCE check because the django backend has no test harness and no
package.json, the same constraint check-run-axes-parity.mjs works around.

parseCases.why: unset falls back to the dev default
empty means empty — an operator who sets it to nothing allows nothing, rather than silently getting the dev list back
blank entries from a trailing comma are dropped, not turned into an empty-string origin that matches nothing
